origin: Own controlled two-state evolutionary method audit on anonymous tips A,B,C,D. Symbols A,C encode mathematical states0,1 at already homologous columns, not functional, coding or organism-specific DNA. PanelA is an exact pattern-proportional alignment construction. PanelB is a DIFFERENT model and supplies only conditional variable-pattern weights. Neither is an empirical taxonomic discovery or a sequencing experiment.
model_scope: Each panel separately obeys a homogeneous stationary symmetric two-state continuous-time Markov model on one unrooted binary quartet. Root state has probability1/2 for each symbol. Every edge independently flips the state with probability p_e in(0,1/2); d_e=-0.5*log(1-2*p_e)>0. Along a path the state correlation is product(1-2*p_e), so pair mismatch p_ij=(1-exp(-2*d_path))/2. Edge probabilities differ between tips and between panels; there is NO shared rate, clock, root position, topology or branch parameter between the panels. Sites are independent under the stipulated population model. No rate mixtures, indels, observation errors or missing states are added.
panel_A: The embedded FASTA is a complete alignment with no gaps or ambiguity; its column counts must match every row of the full pattern table. Acquire and parse the real FASTA, obtain an actual pairwise identity/similarity report, and verify all six pair mismatches against the weighted pattern table. Columns are homologous by construction; do not de novo realign them. Enumerate the full equal-cost two-state Fitch parsimony cost for all three quartet splits, not only informative-site counts. Separately reconstruct the symmetric-Markov-corrected additive distance quartet and all five positive branch probabilities. Retain an actual ParseNewickTreeDistances report for a reconstructed positive-length Newick witness and verify all six distances. That parser checks a supplied tree; it is not the inference algorithm.
panel_A_inference_and_consistency: Treat the normalized full pattern counts as the exact population law for the method audit. Verify the recovered Markov tree reproduces ALL16 pattern probabilities, not just the six pair marginals. Compare the expected per-site parsimony costs and explain which split independent iid sites from this law select as alignment length tends to infinity. More repetitions of this exact panel are not independent biological loci or a remedy for a positive limiting cost gap. Report whether the parsimony estimator is statistically consistent for this stipulated model and whether a root is identified. Do not infer a molecular clock or species history from the supplied branch lengths.
panel_B_ascertainment: Only variable columns were retained: patterns0000 and1111 are absent by design, and their original counts and the unfiltered total were not recorded. relative_variable_weight is an exact CONDITIONAL weight, not an original locus count, inverse-selection weight or prior knowledge of the retained fraction. Normalize these fourteen weights by their own sum. Infer V=P(a site is variable) in(0,1) AND the quartet/positive edge probabilities from panelB alone. Do not borrow panelA topology, parameters, constant fraction or sample size. The stated reversible symmetric model implies the two missing invariant probabilities are each(1-V)/2. A naive distance correction on conditional mismatches can leave its domain; identify every affected pair rather than taking logarithms of nonpositive correlations, clipping or inventing distances.
panel_B_complete_certificate: Enumerate all three unrooted quartet splits and every nonzero candidate V solving their additive-correlation tetrad equality. Discard the algebraic V=0 root; it cannot generate positive variable frequency. For each remaining candidate audit0<V<1, all six unconditional correlations1-2*V*p_variable_ij>0, all reconstructed edge lengths strictly positive, the correct quartet inequality and ALL14 conditional pattern probabilities. A tetrad equality alone can admit a negative internal edge and is not a valid phylogeny. Retain candidate V values and rejection reasons in the trajectory. For the accepted quartet reconstruct all five edge probabilities and reproduce the entire observed conditional table, then provide an actual positive-length Newick parser report. No root is identified merely because a Newick witness has a root for serialization.

interpretation_proposals.A: Unequal branch changes can make the limiting parsimony preference differ from the generating Markov topology.
interpretation_proposals.B: Enough independent columns force every phylogenetic method to converge to the same correct topology.
interpretation_proposals.C: Dropping constant columns changes pair mismatch frequencies and must be modeled before a Markov distance correction.
interpretation_proposals.D: A nonzero tetrad solution always defines a positive-edge tree without checking its domain or quartet inequality.
interpretation_proposals.E: A typed distance report verifies a caller-supplied tree and does not independently infer topology from sequence.
interpretation_proposals.F: An unrooted reversible quartet and a rooted Newick witness identify the evolutionary root or a molecular clock.
interpretation_proposals.G: A full site-pattern check is stronger evidence for the declared tree model than pair-marginal agreement alone.
interpretation_proposals.H: PanelB conditional relative weights reveal its original unfiltered number of loci.

reporting: panel_A_alignment_length; pair_order; panel_A_pair_mismatch_fractions; topology_order; panel_A_total_parsimony_costs and panel_A_expected_parsimony_costs in topology order; panel_A_parsimony_best_split; panel_A_corrected_distance_split; branch_order; panel_A_edge_flip_probabilities; panel_A_maximum_full_pattern_residual; panel_A_parsimony_consistent boolean; panel_B_naive_invalid_distance_pairs; panel_B_nonzero_tetrad_retention_candidates map each split to its V; panel_B_retained_fraction; panel_B_accepted_split; panel_B_edge_flip_probabilities; panel_B_maximum_conditional_pattern_residual; panel_A_root_identified and panel_B_root_identified booleans; valid_interpretation_proposal_ids. Counts/labels/booleans exact, numeric absolute tolerance1e-8; residuals must be nonnegative. Complete raw alignment/table agreement, actual identity report, all per-pattern parsimony costs, corrected distances, all candidate-domain exclusions, full pattern reconstructions and actual tree-parser witnesses belong in the trajectory.

methodological_source.author: J. Felsenstein
methodological_source.title: Cases in which Parsimony or Compatibility Methods will be Positively Misleading
methodological_source.role: Primary context for statistical inconsistency under unequal branch change. Both exact panels and the conditional ascertainment inverse problem are own controlled constructions, not extracted paper datasets or empirical taxa.
